name: Holy Water
description: A flask of clear water, blessed and sealed with wax.
body:
## What it is

Splash it on a creature beside you or hurl the flask up to 20 feet, as an action, a ranged attack with an improvised weapon. A fiend or undead it hits takes 2d6 radiant damage. A cleric or paladin can bless more in an hour-long rite that spends a 1st-level spell slot and 25 gp of powdered silver.
